title: My personal opinion
text: I signed up for this in July and received Van Halen which is a great album. I was hesitant at first due to lots of negative reviews however I believe that the negative reviews are from certain people that just complain about everything and would leave a negative review no matter what. If I had wanted to cancel I saw that in my orders what was coming and it did not ship right away so I could have canceled it with no problem. I would say ignore the negative reviews and try it for yourself you will not be let down. I cant wait till my next one!!!
label: positive
